conclusion: Both outputs support the main cause, protocol field and repair recommendation using raw config, pod events and actual HTTP/2 error logs. Neither asserts global health or sole cause. Item01 still says was killed 3 times in a claim whose own scope correctly says kill attempts; SIGTERM and working-readiness provenance need precision. Item02 has minor capability overstatement and typed temporal-coverage gaps. Positive final-answer results are seeded recovery evidence, not proof of natural error propagation or successful live remediation.
